subject: Onboarding cadence and sequencing — HorizonCare MSA/DPA/order-form roadmap
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@horizoncare.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
Cc: cynthia.li@horizoncare.com
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Onramp sequencing info request and procurement template

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is enthusiastic about Redwood. To make progress on our side I need a clear mutual action plan (MAP) and an itemized sequencing for: MSA redlines, DPA/security review, SOC 2 evidence delivery, and the final order form (billing / Po terms). Can you confirm the following for our procurement & legal teams?

- Typical turnaround for MSA redline negotiation (first pass + counter) and expected owners on your side.
- DPA review: who is our security contact and how long for a first pass? Do you have standard template clauses you prefer?
- SOC 2 / evidence: ability to share report or SOC 2 letter and expected timing.
- Order form / billing: sample order form? options for NET30 vs NET45 and procurement PO process.

I've attached our procurement_template_v2.docx — please propose a MAP with dates so we can align internal stakeholders. Cynthia (CISO) is cc'd for security gating.

Goal: sign MSA+DPA+order form and have pilot running within 5–6 weeks if sequencing looks good on both sides.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Procurement, HorizonCare Systems
attachments: procurement_template_v2.docx (docx)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-09-02T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Onramp sequencing info request and procurement template

Team — forwarding HorizonCare's ask. They want a tight MAP and realistic dates so procurement can commit to pilot timing. Quick proposed split of labor below; aim to send a customer-facing MAP by Friday.

Proposed owners / asks:
- MSA redline negotiation: Marissa lead (legal), target first redline back to customer in 5 business days. Owner: marissa_cole.
- DPA/security review: Neha to own liaison with HorizonCare (CISO Cynthia Li). Provide standard DPA + data flow diagram. Target initial DPA draft in 3 business days. Owner: neha_kapoor.
- SOC 2 evidence: Laura to attach SOC 2 letter and controls summary; expect to share within 48 hours. Owner: laura_bennett.
- Order form & billing: Karthik to confirm payment terms and PO flow (NET30 default; can support NET45 on negotiated deals). Owner: karthik_iyer.
- MAP doc: I'll assemble a 1-page MAP with milestone dates and owners, then send to Sarah for confirmation. Attachment: proposed_map_draft.pdf (internal).

Quick timeline suggestion (subject to legal/procurement back-and-forth):
- Day 0 (today): send MAP + SOC2 + DPA draft + proposed MSA redline schedule
- Day 3–7: customer returns redline / DPA comments
- Day 7–12: resolve redlines, finalize order form
- Day 14–21: signature and PO issuance
- Day 22–35: pilot onramp

If anything here looks optimistic let me know. I'd like Marissa/Neha/Laura to add any constraints or must-haves for deadlines.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-09-03T08:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Onramp sequencing info request and procurement template

Thanks Vivek — couple of legal notes to bake into the MAP before we send externally:

1) MSA redlines: we should push a single consolidated redline exchange cadence (Customer -> Redwood -> Customer) rather than continuous threads. That keeps timelines tight. Target: first redline to us Day 3, our consolidated response Day 5.
2) DPA: provide our standard DPA + a short FAQ on data residency and retention (HorizonCare may ask on PHI handling). Ask: Cynthia please confirm whether HorizonCare will need a specific clause for patient-data segmentation.
3) Order form: confirm that the customer uses purchase orders. If they do, we accept PO + signed order form. If they insist on milestone-based billing, we need to coordinate billing ops (lead: karthik).
4) IP/indemnity: expect 1–2 negotiation points; include fallback language for standard indemnities — put those in the MAP as assumed items to negotiate.

I'll prepare a redline checklist and a short set of proposed fallback positions (attachment: Redwood_Redline_Checklist.pdf). Also recommend we include a DocuSign envelope link for MSA once legal sign-off.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Redline_Checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-09-05T14:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Onramp sequencing info request and procurement template

A few procurement sequencing notes from my side:

- Payment terms: default NET30 on hosted API usage. For enterprise pilots we can accept NET45 provided a signed PO is in place with committed usage bands. If HorizonCare wants NET60, escalate to finance (longer review).
- PO process: we accept emailed POs as long as they reference the signed order form and deal id.
- Acceptance criteria: suggest a phased acceptance schedule in the MAP: 1) connectivity & test tokens (Day 0–3), 2) validation run (Days 4–10), 3) performance acceptance (Days 11–14). Each phase sign-off by HorizonCare technical lead (add to MAP).
- Dependencies matrix: add legal sign-off (MSA/DPA) as a hard gate before provisioning production keys. Pilot infra can be provisioned with test keys earlier.

I'll add a short procurement lane to the MAP and flag items that require finance approval.

Karthik
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@horizoncare.com>
Cc: Cynthia Li <cynthia.li@horizoncare.com>, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-09-12T13:02:00Z
Subject: HorizonCare MAP & sequencing (MSA/DPA/order form) — proposed dates and owners

Hi Sarah / Cynthia — appreciated the quick turnaround. Attached is our one-page MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf) and a short sequencing checklist. Highlights below (please confirm acceptance or adjustments):

Milestones & owners:
- Day 0 (today): Redwood shares MAP + SOC 2 letter + DPA draft + proposed MSA negotiation cadence — Owner: Vivek / Laura / Neha / Marissa
- Day 3: HorizonCare returns MSA redline & DPA comments — Owner: Sarah / Legal
- Day 5: Redwood consolidated MSA response & updated DPA — Owner: Marissa / Neha
- Day 8: Finalize order form (billing terms & PO) — Owner: Karthik / Sarah
- Day 12: Signatures via DocuSign -> provisioning of pilot test tokens — Owner: Sarah / Vivek
- Day 12–22: Pilot validation and performance acceptance — Owner: HorizonCare Tech Lead / Redwood Engineering

Dependencies and notes:
- MSA and DPA must be signed before production keys are issued. We can provision test credentials earlier for validation runs.
- SOC 2: Laura has attached the SOC 2 letter (see drive link). If HorizonCare requires a SOC 2 report access, we can initiate an NDA and share the report within 48 hours.
- Data residency: Neha — please follow up with Cynthia on any PHI segmentation requirements.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf) — Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-HorizonCare-Onramp
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/placeholder/horizoncare-msa

Next step: can we pencil in a 30-minute kickoff for this Friday 09/17 to walk through the MAP and owners? Two slots I can offer: 10:00 AM PT or 3:00 PM PT.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@horizoncare.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
Cc: cynthia.li@horizoncare.com
Date: 2026-09-18T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: HorizonCare MAP & sequencing (MSA/DPA/order form) — proposed dates and owners

Vivek — thank you for the MAP and clear owners. We're aligned on most items; two asks before kickoff:

1) Payment term tweak: HorizonCare prefers NET45 for the pilot. We're OK with NET30 after production if usage patterns are standard. Please confirm finance sign-off.
2) SOC 2 access: Cynthia would like the full SOC 2 report (not just the letter). We'll sign your standard NDA for report access.

We reviewed your proposed schedule and can meet Friday 09/17 at 3:00 PM PT — please confirm and send a calendar invite. Also attaching our PO template for reference.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Procurement, HorizonCare Systems
attachments: horizoncare_po_template.pdf (pdf)
